content.title: Candid Observer Follow | Incidental Interruption, Awkward Recovery, Continued Departure
content.summary: Follow one clearly adult subject through a coherent public route with imperfect handheld framing. Let an incidental person or object force a genuine path correction, observe one compact social mishap without staged coverage, then return to the route and end as the subject continues away while an independent environmental event completes the scene.

quick_start.input_format: clearly adult subject + continuous rear observer-follow route + incidental path correction + imperfect handheld recovery + compact social microevent + continued departure with independent environment closure
quick_start.recommended_input: Record a native-vertical handheld follow of an adult night-shift radio technician walking through a coastal weather station. A cable cart forces one imperfect sidestep; adult colleagues inspect a mislabeled sample, a paper cup tips harmlessly, and the technician laughs once before continuing toward the antenna deck as a distant warning beacon begins rotating.
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult subject, one observer-follow axis and recurring route landmarks before the first interruption.
Let one incidental person, object or route event force a visible path correction without a reset.
Observe at least one compact social microevent with a readable reaction and recovery.
Return to route continuation and end with one independent environmental event rather than a posed finale.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Follow one clearly adult subject through a coherent public route with imperfect handheld framing. Let an incidental person or object force a genuine path correction, observe one compact social mishap without staged coverage, then return to the route and end as the subject continues away while an independent environmental event completes the scene.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Follow one clearly adult original subject from behind through a coherent public route using imperfect handheld framing. Establish recurring landmarks, allow one incidental person or object to force a real path correction, then observe one or two compact social microevents without converting them into staged coverage. Preserve delayed reframing, awkward pauses and environmental interruptions as evidence of observation. End with the subject continuing along the same route while one independent background event completes the scene. The reusable mechanism is continuous observer relation, incidental encounter, imperfect recovery, compact social reaction and continued departure—not the source woman, clothing, drink, Japanese town, older pedestrian, cafe, ice cream, bridge, train, vertical prompt wording, camera timing, creator identity or Seedance 2.5 claim.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult subject, one observer-follow axis and recurring route landmarks before the first interruption.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the footage legible as one observed journey.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated locations make an ordinary montage rather than a follow encounter.

invariants.rule: Let one incidental person, object or route event force a visible path correction without a reset.
invariants.purpose: Provides an unplanned-looking encounter and causal camera response.
invariants.ablation_failure: A perfectly blocked pass removes the observational evidence.

invariants.rule: Retain small framing errors, delayed recentering and awkward pauses while preserving subject identity.
invariants.purpose: Creates candid credibility without sacrificing continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Perfect stabilized coverage reads as a staged commercial.

invariants.rule: Observe at least one compact social microevent with a readable reaction and recovery.
invariants.purpose: Gives the route a human change rather than scenery alone.
invariants.ablation_failure: A reaction-free walk lacks reusable narrative progression.

invariants.rule: Return to route continuation and end with one independent environmental event rather than a posed finale.
invariants.purpose: Closes the journey while preserving the observer relationship.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping for a hero pose breaks the candid contract.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's likeness, hair, clothing, drink, gestures and exact backward glances
the source Japanese mountain town, street, pedestrian, vending machine, storefront, cafe, bridge, railway and red train
the source companions, ice-cream activity, dropped item, reactions and relationship staging
the source camera route, 3:4 instruction, framing errors, timing, color and exact event order
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
